rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something very intense or someone exceptionally capable.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 biu2 jin6 hou2 ging6 wo3

rows.note: Use this when the degree is strikingly high or remarkable, especially with speed, size, or other measurable intensity.

example.english: The runner ran at a terrific speed.
example.traditional: 個運動員跑得快得驚人。
example.jyutping: go3 wan6 dung6 jyun4 paau2 dak1 faai3 dak1 ging1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for approving of a person, performance, or thing as excellent rather than describing physical intensity.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 zing3
